notes.title: Radical Relocation: Race Track free roam update!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Hate that feeling of just barely failing a level because you didn't take that sharp turn properly? Do you long for the feeling of the wind in your hair as you punch the gas? Well, we have good news for you. Introducing the new Race Track free roam map!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/f833d47db2584bf5b0001012018c5970300d1727.gif

The name really should speak for itself. It's a race track that you can roam around freely to sharpen your driving skills, or just to relax and drift/bump around. Oh, and we know what gets the dopamine flowing, so of course we added a ramp.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/95f9248e58689f98cac65921f246576e2aadd9de.gif

Additionally, Radical Relocation is now 35% off! Make sure to grab the game if you haven't already, and tell your friends.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/816430/Radical_Relocation/ 

We hope you enjoy the race track!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33747657/9119f9723f0fc27715ad69be3a3dbd2c57eb6f99.png

notes.title: Our Lunar New Year update has arrived!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We've been tinkering away behind the scenes, and are happy to present you with our latest major update! In honor of the Lunar New Year being just around the corner, we've created a bunch of new maps to celebrate.

Without further ado, let's get into the patch notes!

Additions
First, we've added twenty new playable levels! You can leave your cars in the garage for these, because they're for the Island and Arctic regions. Both regions have received 10 new levels that will prove to be quite the challenge, even for experienced players.

Here's a quick flyby of what you can expect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/2a57cf054d216597d427e5a53a1ce6be9284389c.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/dde37bee825db7c07dd5d8a244505772ef3321df.gif


Adjustments

 Removed sharks too close to cliffs
 Increased distance between cargo ship spawning
 Camera tilts further down for boats
 Updated main menu preview video
 Added UI screenshots for new levels
 Made all furniture float during edit mode
 Centered level 81 map
 Adjusted height of map render per region to avoid clipping
 Interpolate input after pause to reduce boats suddenly stopping after pausing


Fixes

 Fixed camera rotation on pallets
 Fixed log cabin object layer
 Fixed furniture sliding down front of airboat
 Fixed multiple music tracks playing simultaneously
 Fixed map render in map 51 and 56 blank
 Fixed dragging furniture when garage is open
 Fixed camera movement when garage is open
 Fixed boats not pausing when input is held down during the pause
 Fixed some non-game-ending destructible items not ending the game on collision with the ground and water


Give the new levels a whirl, and let us know what you think on Discord!

notes.title: Free Holiday Update! Snow + Presents!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're looking forward to the holidays as much as we are! In fact, we're so excited that we decided to make an entire holiday update for Radical Relocation. You'll now find every map covered in a thick layer of snow, presents to relocate, and other trinkets and baubles.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/f0aa1b7754eddfcc86af324a091756470e050d27.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/4c2415349c8f86ba9a66a14c31fa5aa7837f5096.gif

Thank you so much for supporting us in 2020! We've got more content for Radical Relocation on the horizon, including some additional levels in the arctic and island regions, but for now, we hope you enjoy the snow!

Happy holidays, and don't forget to come hang out with us on Discord.

notes.title: UPDATE: Improved stacking system, vehicle handling and SHARKS
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Having fun but wish there were more ways to wreck carnage around your neighborhood? Well, now you have some new items you can DESTROY! But watch out, there’s something sinister lurking in the waters...

In this update we’ve added a new furniture movement system. Players can now vertically adjust furniture to alter stacking height. This makes it easier to arrange items onto your vehicle and create your abstract take on lady liberty. 

Make a great first impression on your neighbors by ramming through letterboxes, pot plants, BBQ, dead trees, beds, and much more! But watch out on the boat levels. A not so friendly face has been added and he won’t be easy to shake. No matter how many times you run him over with your propeller. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/ba5d2a139043e5eaf3f9f95ed6b7b969aeece45f.jpg

On top of that, we’ve improved our vehicle mechanics to make your moving experience run smoother.

Vehicle improvements: 

 Added hand brake
 Improved drifting behavior 
 Better car suspension
 Better vehicle suspension with small objects
 Increased vehicle reverse speed
 Improved camera system


Since our last update, we’ve managed to fix several bugs in the game and a lot of small improvements. Please check out our Discord for the full change log!

notes.title: UPDATE: Leaderboard improvement, Japanese localization, and more!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Time for another update. We've been receiving a lot of love from our Japanese players, so we're happy to announce that Japanese language options are now available!

Leaderboard change
As for changes, one major change we've made is that leaderboards now have milliseconds, as opposed to just seconds. This means you can now properly see how well you're doing against other speedrunners! For those who like photo finishes, this one's for you.

Funny bug, no more
We've also fixed a pretty major (and, not gonna lie, very funny) bug that caused furniture to fly off extremely fast when you hit a curb. See This LIRIK clip if you haven't encountered it. Some say it was ghosts that caused it.

More changes!
As for other improvements, balance changes, and bug fixes, we have a brand new changelog channel on our Discord. If you want to stay up to date on the very latest news, make sure you join us!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35965266/37a6de2a62ca36fe8341e71a01a434f4131ca88a.jpg
Speaking of Discord, today's update image is brought to you by Discord user Civantr. Who knows how it got up there, probably ghosts again.

That's the gist of it! Again, more changes and fixes on our Discord :)
